label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Koepka Returns to PGA Tour
items.text: Brooks Koepka has been warmly welcomed back to the PGA Tour after leaving LIV Golf 10 months ago but has yet to regain form, missing the FedEx Cup Playoffs as he aims for a 2027 Ryder Cup spot.

items.headline: Tiger Woods to Play Hero World
items.text: Tiger Woods announced he will play his first individual tournament in over two years at the upcoming Hero World Challenge.

items.headline: Horschel Withdraws from RSM Classic
items.text: Billy Horschel withdrew from the RSM Classic with a rib injury, putting his full PGA Tour status for 2027 at risk due to his current No. 101 FedExCup Fall standing.
